MARK JOSHUA EVANGELISTA markjoshua.evangelista@gmail.com Dear Mr. Evangelista: This refers to your email requesting for an opinion on a matter concerning the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) budget. Below is the issue submitted for our opinion, quoted hereunder in toto: I have a question lang regarding po sa role ni contractor sa annual budget ng SK Council. Sila po ba ang dapat na mag budget at mag canvas every time na mayroong project ang SK? Please be informed that contractors are not authorized to prepare the SK budget or conduct canvassing for SK projects. Under the provisions of Republic Act No. 10742, or the Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015, the preparation of the annual budget and the canvassing of goods and services are duties vested in the SK officials, particularly the SK Treasurer and the SK Chairperson, subject to the approval of the Sangguniang Barangay. The role of contractors is limited to the execution of projects and services awarded to them following the appropriate procurement process as prescribed by Republic Act No. 9184, or the Government Procurement Reform Act, and its Implementing Rules and Regulations, as amended by R.A. No. 12009 or the New Government Procurement Act. The opinion is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO .
